classification.reason: The product FAQ directly explains how to invite a teammate as an Editor via Settings > Members > Invite, with no refund, fraud, or discretionary-exception concerns present.

draft.reply:
Hi there,

You can invite your coworker as an Editor right from your workspace settings:

1. Go to Settings > Members > Invite
2. Enter their email address
3. Choose the "Editor" role
4. Send the invite

They'll receive an email invitation to join — just note that the invite link expires after 7 days, so if they don't accept it in time you'll need to resend it.

Let us know if you run into any issues!

Best,
The Loopwise Team
